ai_summary: Capital NxT LLP, along with its Persons Acting in Concert (PAC), acquired additional shares of 3i Infotech Limited through open market transactions, increasing their collective stake to 5.02%. This acquisition surpasses the 5% threshold, mandating a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a significant, non-promoter shareholding. A notable red flag is that the reported transaction dates (July 19-20, 2026) are set in the future, suggesting a potential error in dating or a forward-looking disclosure.
